summary: Gray Media filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $70M aggregate principal amount of 7.250% Senior Secured First Lien Notes due 2033 via a private placement under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. The Additional Notes were issued at 100% par plus accrued interest and rank equally with the existing $775M same-series notes. Proceeds funded $40M of consideration for the first... The filing is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
